CRAS: a2dp_iodev - Fix socket depth frames We use setsockopt to configure the A2DP socket depth (i.e the maximum send buffer of socket). However kernel has its own logic to determine the actual final value, and it may not equal to what we set. According to net/core/sock.c Fix A2DP socket depth by using getsockopt to query the actual value. This will make our A2DP delay report more accurate. BUG=b:132130485 TEST=Test Sony WH-1000Xm3 headset on Atlas, this change corrects about 3000 frames of delay. Launch AV sync video on web based YouTube to verify the sync is a lot better. Change-Id: I0c8b78f956372e375215ece556b5e2ee5d8d13a0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1695222 Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Chih-Yang Hsia <paulhsia@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org>

CRAS: Remove frames from input devices when missing callback The stream may miss callback due to audio thread wake up late. For that situation, we will reset stream's schedule to fix it. However, it also makes some frames remain in the device permanently. To avoid increasing delay, we can keep the hw_level less than 2 * largest_cb_level. When it exceeds, adjust the number of frames to earliest min_cb_ts of all input devices by dropping frames. BUG=chromium:918462 TEST=The hardware level doesn't increase when missing callback. (Test on Panther) Change-Id: Ie1d9020bddb57c0a2d14a1b1eeb22d3bd4449749 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1673766 Tested-by: Yu-Hsuan Hsu <yuhsuan@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Yu-Hsuan Hsu <yuhsuan@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org>

crosh/debugd: Don't anonymize MACs in network_diag There's an inconsistency with how we anonymize MACs for feedback reports in that it is done in network_diag and then again in the anonymizer in debugd & Chrome. This removes one layer of the redaction so it can be then done (later) in a singular place so that we have consistency amongst all redacted MAC addresses in the logs. For now it is still done in two places (debugd & Chrome). This also changes the default to NOT anonymize the output because on manual invocation, that is likely more desirable and we control the automated invocations of it which have been updated with the new parameter. BUG=chromium:673939 TEST=Manually verified redaction in feedback report Change-Id: Icf8f61586fe249d066442bf14f30cd207b07af05 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1697526 Tested-by: Jeffrey Kardatzke <jkardatzke@google.com> Commit-Ready: Jeffrey Kardatzke <jkardatzke@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>
